_about: Round 40, written by shape (docs/SHAPES.md): units for the steady screens, the most common ones. 'fact' is an index into facts.<key> (steady_night: into NIGHT in make_round40.py). 'cut' marks a line the critic pass took out, with the rule.

10.joke: Nothing for me to do all day. I'll still look busy.
Today I'm basically a picture frame. A smug one.
The weather's on autopilot. So am I.
Same outfit all day. I've worn the same frame for years.
You won't need me again today. Rude, but true.
Easy day. I'll take full credit anyway.
If anything changes, it wasn't in my forecast. So it won't.
I checked every hour. Nothing. Riveting stuff.
One outfit, zero updates. My dream schedule.
10.cut: a vetoed idea in the same slot ('Easiest money I never made')

10.joke: Today's forecast fits on a sticky note.
10.cut: a near-copy of a vetoed line

11.joke: The weather's fine with your outfit. That makes one of us.
The day's sorted. Your hair, less so.
You'll stand in front of the mirror anyway. It won't help.
No layers to lose today. You'll lose your keys instead.
The forecast is easy today. You, as always, are not.
You'll wear it all day. Then, knowing you, tomorrow too.
Dressed right? For the weather, yes.
You'll feel right at home. Nothing ever changes with you either.
No weather drama today, so you'll have to make your own.
11.cut: a live line's idea ('So any drama today is your own work.')

11.joke: You got dressed right on the first try. Mark the date.

11.joke: Nice of the weather to make an effort. Someone had to.

10.joke: The weather's done for today. I'm not. I never am.
Whatever happens tonight, the forecast was right.
If the evening goes wrong, I have an alibi.
Evening plans? The weather has none either.
I'd go out tonight myself. No legs, sadly.
A quiet evening. My favorite kind of forecast.
I'll just be up here, being decor.
10.cut: a live line's idea ('I'll go back to looking decorative.')

10.joke: I'd go out, but I can't leave the wall.
10.cut: owner: not every TRMNL is on a wall

11.joke: The weather won't ruin tonight. You might.
You'll change into sweatpants anyway. They'd work too.
You'll say you're going out. You won't.
Perfect evening for that thing you keep putting off. You won't.
Whatever you do tonight, you'll do it in this. Bold.
You'll spend twenty minutes picking a show.

11.joke: You'll check me again before bed. I'll still say this.

10.joke: I'll keep watch. It's not like I sleep.
I'd yawn, if I could.
I checked until morning so you don't have to.

10.joke: Night mode: same forecast, fewer readers.

The night is calm. Your browser history, less so.

10.joke: I wouldn't know. I run warm.

The cold keeps its word today. I respect that.
Don't blame me. I only report it.
